response.original_title: [{Senior Travel→Help}] Does Qantas give a discount for seniors?
response.overview: Does Qantas offer discounted ☏ +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK) airfares for seniors, children and infants? Qantas does not offer concessional airfares for seniors and children (2-11 years) for domestic travel. Concessional airfares are available ☏ +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK) for children and infants for international travel (conditions apply).
